items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: the team was Williams and Walker before it become Bert Williams

ctx.x: the Dark Town Poker Club, play cards, poker and do it by himself on the stage, play poker, let you see him in a poker game which is immense. Then he had a partner -- the team was Williams and Walker before it become Bert Williams. Bert Williams become the comedian and got in this show. But Williams and Walker was a team just like Buck and Bubbles is a team and I go in another show and Buck ain't here. Bert Williams did the same thing. His wife, Bert Williams' wife -- walker's wife, she used to dress like nobody's…

Same as Noble Sissle, I figured he could make more money with his band than he could with his partner, but he didn't. In my estimation he didn't. He went to the dogs it seemed to me after that, but God rest his soul, he was all right.
